plates.quality_reason: Quality: readable faces (German ophthalmologist Carl von Hess in 1910 claiming invertebrates are colour-blind, answered by young Austrian zoologist Karl Ritter von Frisch in 1914 placing a blue card inside a checkerboard of 30 grey cards to prove honeybees see colour, and at Brunnwinkl in Summer 1944–1946 watching paint-numbered bees in a glass observation hive perform the figure-eight waggle dance).
